items.name: base
items.title: ViteHub base
items.description: Start an app on ViteHub UI: `shadcn-vue init --preset https://vitehub.dev/r/base.json`. It adds the @vitehub registry, Lucide icons, the theme, and the core stylesheet. It installs no Reka UI.

items.name: theme
items.title: ViteHub theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens with ViteHub values, light and dark.

items.name: core
items.title: ViteHub core
items.description: vitehub.css: the ui-sdk stylesheet, the shadcn tokens mapped onto its --ui-* variables, the status colors, and the focus ring. Every component item imports it.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A dot in a status color with an optional label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A button that copies text and shows a check for a moment.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn of a conversation: avatar, header, content, and footer, aligned to the start or end.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A frame for message text in five variants and a tone, with groups and reactions.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file with its upload status as a row or a tile, with media, actions, and a group that scrolls.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: A chat input with file attachments and a submit button that follows the AI SDK chat status.

items.name: example-status
items.title: Status example
items.description: Every tone of Status, with and without a label.

items.name: example-copy-button
items.title: Copy button example
items.description: An icon-only copy button and one with a label.

items.name: example-message
items.title: Message example
items.description: A question from the user and an answer with a header and footer.

items.name: example-bubble
items.title: Bubble example
items.description: A group of bubbles with a reaction and a button, and the outline and destructive variants.

items.name: example-attachment
items.title: Attachment example
items.description: Attachments in three sizes and statuses, and a group of chips.

items.name: example-prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input example
items.description: A prompt that takes text and files and shows what it sent.

items.name: vitehub-ui-skill
items.title: ViteHub UI agent skill
items.description: A skill that tells a coding agent how to use, style, and install ViteHub UI parts.
